meta.title: chore(ci): Make the core CICD workflows failfast (#32768)
meta.body_summary: Implement fail-fast behavior in dotCMS core CI/CD workflows by setting fail-fast: true, replacing static test matrices with dynamic generation from a centralized test-matrix.yml, and refining yq‑based configuration processing.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code CI fail-fast refactor with dynamic matrix; cursor bot flagged bugs (yq quoting, E2E args) that were fixed before merge with two human approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 484 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. It introduces a centralized test-matrix.yml and rewrites the CI phase, fitting a moderately sized infrastructure performance PR that was merged after bot-flagged fixes and human approvals.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] found three issues: 1) yq command with quoted file path causes failure; 2) E2E test suites overwrite base_maven_args, breaking execution; 3) Karate test report upload missing and dotcms-license parameter handling issue. spbolton responded to the E2E args concern that it should be resolved, and the final commit 'fixes from cursorbot' addressed the yq quoting.
review_details.performance_claim: Fail-fast reduces time to failure detection from 30+ min to 5-10 min, saves CI resources.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI/CD pipeline refactoring with GitHub Actions, dynamic matrix generation, yq, and JavaScript scripting falls within the technical stack of DevOps tooling, requiring knowledge of workflow syntax, YAML, and bash. The agent's initial submission had implementation bugs that were caught by an automated review bot, but after human-assisted fixes, it was accepted.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] performed a detailed review of the diff, identifying three specific bugs (yq file path quoting, E2E maven args combination, missing karate report upload and license parameter). spbolton reviewed and stated the E2E issue should be resolved, and the final commit fixed the yq quoting.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No CI benchmark data provided; the performance claims are based on logical reduction in execution time rather than measured before/after. The fail-fast behavior is deterministic, so no empirical evidence was required by reviewers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All bot-flagged issues were addressed: yq quoting fixed, E2E maven args combination clarified (spbolton said it should be resolved), and a commit 'fixes from cursorbot' was added.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced fail-fast strategy by setting `fail-fast: true` in the test matrix, replacing static matrix listings with dynamic generation from a centralized `.github/test-matrix.yml`. The `setup-matrix` job uses yq and a JavaScript GitHub Action to generate test configurations with combined maven args.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added test-matrix.yml and refactored cicd_comp_test-phase.yml with dynamic matrix and fail-fast.
Subsequent commits: fixed yq action usage, test step goals, combination of base maven args, and pinned action version.
After cursor bot flagged bugs, commits addressed yq quoting and other fixes.
Two human approvals and merge ~30 hours after creation.
